patches.old_text: Stripe-hosted UIs (Checkout, Payment Links, Elements, Terminal) auto-display network selector when applicable. Connect platforms using `on_behalf_of` must pass `onBehalfOf` to establish merchant of record.
patches.new_text: In Stripe's 2026-05-01 guide, hosted UIs (Checkout, Payment Links, Elements, Terminal) display a network selector when applicable and configured for the variant. For Connect platforms using `on_behalf_of` with separate charges and transfers or destination charges, the guide places `onBehalfOf` in the relevant UI configuration so Stripe can determine whether to display the selector; merchant-of-record applicability can attach to the platform or connected account. The 2026-11-07 default page is navigation only and does not revalidate those variant instructions.
patches.reason: Directly narrows an overbroad Connect requirement and dates behavioral support to the fully read May guide; old lines 61–65, 89–93, 141–145, 187–191, 218–222.

patches.old_text: **Mobile SDKs** (`preferredNetworks`): iOS 23.22.1+ / Android 20.37.4+ required. For connect: `onBehalfOf` in `IntentConfiguration`.
patches.new_text: **Mobile SDKs, May 2026 guide** (`preferredNetworks`): iOS 23.22.1+ / Android 20.37.4+ is the selection baseline shown for Payment Sheet, Embedded Payment Element, Customer Sheet and Card Element. For the specified Connect `on_behalf_of` flows, Payment Sheet and Embedded Payment Element put `onBehalfOf` in `IntentConfiguration`; Mobile Card Element puts it on the Card Element variant and requires iOS 23.27.1+ / Android 20.42.0+ for that path.
patches.reason: Corrects the mobile Card Element's distinct Connect placement and higher SDK minimum without generalizing the November navigation index into current SDK evidence; old lines 232–259, 291–320, 350–399.
